question: Which is the only active volcano in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Barren Island**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Barren Island** is the only active volcano in India.
 
• It is located in the **Bay of Bengal.**
 
• Barren Island is a group of **Andaman Island.**
 
• It is the only confirmed** active volcano in South Asia.****​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Deccan Trap**
 
 
 
• The Deccan Traps are one of the **largest volcanic** provinces in the world.
 
• The Deccan Traps is in the Indian states of **Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, and Maharashtra.**
 
• It consists of a composite thickness of more than 6,500 feet of flat-lying basalt lava and covers an area of nearly 500,000 square km in west-central India.
 
• The Deccan Traps are **flood basalts** similar to the Columbia River basalts of the northwestern United States.
 
 
 
 

 **Baratang Island**
 
 
 
• It is a part of the **Andaman and Nicobar Island.**
 
• It is located between **South and Middle Andaman.**
 
• Located in the **Bay of Bengal.**
 
 
 
 

 **Narcondam Island**
 
 
 
• It is considered a dormant volcano.
 
• The island is part of the Indian union territory of the **Andaman and Nicobar Islands.**
 
• It is located in the **Bay of Bengal.**
